footprint: One footprint per acquisition in Airbus's catalog.
cloud: For the whole acquisition, so a cloudy one can still be clear over a small site.
scope: Airbus's own catalog (OneAtlas STAC API): what has been collected. Off-nadir is the incidence angle at the ground, a little larger than the satellite's off-nadir angle. CSDA's own Airbus holdings are tracked on the Airbus augmentation page, so In CSDA is not shown here.

levels.plain: Archive catalog record (orderable as ortho, projected or sensor products)
